title: Watch Duty: Creeper Watch
summary: Something blew a hole in the baker's wall. The Watch thinks there are more of them about.

dialogue.intro: Something blew a hole in the baker's wall last night. Green, quiet, and there are more of them.
offer: Five of them, at least. Get them before they get to the houses.
dialogue.reward: No more holes. Here's the Watch's thanks.
dialogue.done: Not a single new hole in a wall since.
